details: Permanently deleted product "Dr. Scent HVAC Central Scent System 5000" (DSC-HVAC-5000) from catalogue.

previousValue.name: Dr. Scent HVAC Central Scent System 5000
previousValue.tagline: Commercial AHU/HVAC duct-integrated scent architecture for large venues
previousValue.shortDescription: Direct HVAC ductwork integration unit. Delivers completely invisible, uniform scent distribution across entire hotel lobbies, conference centres, and flagship retail.
previousValue.description: Designed specifically for mechanical contractors, facility directors, and luxury hoteliers. The HVAC 5000 connects directly into central air handling units (AHU) or duct systems. Utilizing advanced dual-fluid sub-micron atomization, the fragrance molecules stay suspended in airflow without adhering to duct walls or filters.
